📖 Game script

Philadelphia plays without DeVonta Smith, Hollywood Brown and Dallas Goedert (all out on the 10/03 feed) plus its second tight end, so the offense narrows to Jalen Hurts' legs (+175 to score, per Gilles Gallant) and Saquon Barkley (69+ rushing, +116). Showers are likely during the game (NWS 77% at 2 PM ET). The Rams move the ball at 6.3 yards per play: Matthew Stafford (250+) to Puka Nacua (67+ at −114; Brandon Anderson has his catches over 6.5) and Davante Adams (+116 to score), and Kyren Williams at −118 to score. The Eagles score 18.3 a game. Rams by five, covering −3.5; 41 points, under 42.5.

🧠 Why the card leans this way

The named experts lean PHI: Steve Fezzik (Even Money, +3.5 contest pick and +3 for 2 units, citing the Rams' travel), Sharp or Square (Simon Hunter), Chad Millman (+3), Matt Moore (+2.5), Jason Radowitz of BettingPros (+3) and a Ross Tucker lean. LAR: BettingPros (−2.5), Andrew Erickson and Action Network's preview (−3.5), Matt Youmans of VSiN (moneyline, a best bet), Joe Gibbs (−3; home dogs cover 37% under this referee), Evan Abrams and Mike Florio (Rams 30–20). Dave Tuley of VSiN passes. Read in full, the columns split 7–6 toward the Rams. Tickets are 50/50 on the spread, but 61% of the money is on LAR; the PHI moneyline has 23% of tickets and 15% of money. The line went from the Action Network open of LAR −2.5 to −3.5, and the total from 46 to 42.5, as the receiver news landed. The half point is Action Network against Bookmaker and could be book noise, but it crosses the 3. Most of the PHI backers bet before the receivers were ruled out, but there's a real counterweight: Evan Abrams' primer has four systems on the Eagles (a team that lost by 20 last week, underdogs off a blowout loss, fading the public after a poor offensive game, and a first-half version), so the Rams side is better as the moneyline or a parlay leg than the spread at −3.5. The lean is LAR and the under, plus Williams to score. Card: the LAR moneyline is in the Slot 3 Morning parlay, LAR −3 is a proposed SuperContest pick (book −3.5 on both SuperContest tickets), and Matthew Stafford 2+ passing TDs is in the 7a Morning prop stack. The under is left off (no full-game unders in parlays).

⚠️ What breaks it

Barkley breaks a long run; Brandon Anderson has his longest rush over 30 at +450. Fezzik's travel case is real: a third straight trip for the Rams. Colby Parkinson is questionable for LA. Heavy rain would also slow the Rams' passing game and turn a five-point margin into a field goal.
